scope: Post-result exploratory signal integrity audit; no network access, no inference, no relabeling, no outcome changes
limits: Signal flags are only listening candidates; quiet intros, pauses, clipping or fades can be in the source music.
Byte-exact reconstruction shows saved WAV matches the cached MP3; partial prefixes lack an independent full upstream checksum.
No automatic genre adjudication or human listening was performed by this audit.
Exact duplicate checks do not establish absence of near duplicates, alternate encodings or versions.
Uploader tags describe whole songs and may omit valid styles; a label-based false positive is not necessarily a human-confirmed genre mistake.
